description: This file defines API client functions for interacting with a backend service, including functions for importing test plans, fetching test suite data, and resolving the API base URL. It exports several functions used for communication with the backend API in a React frontend context.

methods.name: resolveApiBase()
methods.description: Determines the backend API base URL based on environment variables, window location, or default fallback.

methods.name: readJsonOrText(resp)
methods.description: Reads the response content as JSON if possible; otherwise, returns text or an error object.

methods.name: buildUrl(path, query)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL with optional query parameters based on the API base.

methods.name: importTestPlanFile(file)
methods.description: Uploads a test plan file (CSV/XLSX) to the backend import endpoint.

methods.name: fetchSuites()
methods.description: Fetches all test suites from the backend.

methods.name: fetchSuiteTestcases({ suiteId, page = 1, pageSize = 20, category, priority, search })
methods.description: Fetches paginated test cases within a specified test suite, with optional filtering options.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Returns the resolved API base URL for use elsewhere in the application.

ctags.name: fetchSuiteTestcases
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchSuiteTestcases({ suiteId, page = 1, pageSize = 20, category, priority/
ctags.signature: ({ suiteId, page = 1, pageSize = 20, category, priority, search })
